commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+5' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) inside the box. Corner kick. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity.
90+3' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+3' The attendance for today's match is 30775.
90+1' The expression of the referee Mario Melero is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) is shown a yellow card.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A cross by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
87' Fouls committed – 15:12.
85' Here is a change. Sandro Ramirez is going off and Diego Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas).
85' Substitution. Javier Munoz makes his way off the pitch and Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) comes on as his replacement.
85' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Javi Lopez and he is replaced by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
85' Substitution. Mikel Oyarzabal did his best and is replaced by Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad).
81' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' Referee Mario Melero sees the trip by Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
79' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
78' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
78' Real Sociedad keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
77' A pass into the box finds Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Jasper Cillessen denies him.
75' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

75' The game is pretty dull as Las Palmas are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. Las Palmas get a corner.
74' The whistle blows and Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is booked for an infringement.
73' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is booked for saying more than Mario Melero was willing to tolerate.
73' Diego Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) replacing Jose Campana.
72' It will be a substitution. Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) is ready to enter the pitch as Jaime Mata walks off.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.

70' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom left corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save. Real Sociedad win a corner.
69' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
68' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Jasper Cillessen stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
67' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) replaces Takefusa Kubo.
67' A substitution has been made. Brais Mendez is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.

63' Real Sociedad play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. Real Sociedad force their opponents to concede a corner.
62' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Alex Remiro makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marvin (Las Palmas) for Alberto Moleiro.
58' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) shows his willingness to get forward and blasts a shot towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the shot isn't precise enough and hits the crossbar!
57' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is yellow-carded.
54' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) brings his opponent down. Mario Melero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
51' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is adjudged offside.
49' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
48' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) makes a strong challenge and Mario Melero blows for a foul.
46' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' The ball is out of play and Las Palmas manage to earn a corner. Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' The free kick is delivered by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

45+1' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mario Melero with no other option than to blow for a foul. Las Palmas are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 64:36.
42' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
42' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad). Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
40' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
40' The game is interrupted now, Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
39' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) attempts to discuss the decision with Mario Melero, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
38' The free kick from long range, taken by Real Sociedad, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
37' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
36' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
33' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mario Melero blows for a foul.
31' A clumsy foul by Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) and Mario Melero blows his whistle.
29' Mario Melero interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jose Campana (Las Palmas).
27' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
25' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) wastes a huge chance. He collects a rebound but fires against the left post!

23' Good clearance! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
21' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

20' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) commits a foul and Mario Melero immediately signals a free kick.
18' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. That's a free kick to Las Palmas.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.

17' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Alex Remiro's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom left corner. The linesman makes the right call and Las Palmas will have a corner.
16' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mario Melero saw the whole situation.
14' The linesman signals that Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
13' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
13' Las Palmas failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Las Palmas can continue in their attacking effort.
12' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save. The ball is out of play. Las Palmas win a corner kick.
11' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

11' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Las Palmas.
9' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
6' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
5' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

4' Good clearance! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
3' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
1' The first half has started.
Las Palmas will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Mario Melero.
